capabilities.name: Diary Entry Recording
capabilities.notes: The repository provides the underlying storage and indexing engine (full-text, SQL) required to record diary entries. However, it does not contain the specific application logic for 'operator diary' domain entities or the HTTP POST submission handler itself; this would be implemented in the service layer consuming Manticore.

capabilities.name: Diary Search
capabilities.notes: Manticore provides the core search capabilities (full-text, vector, hybrid) and SQL/HTTP interfaces to query data. The specific 'Diary Search' API endpoint is not in this repo, but the engine supports the required search functionality.

evidence.claim: Manticore Search is an open-source search database for full-text, vector, and hybrid search with real-time indexing and SQL.
Topics include full-text-search, sql, search-api, sphinxsearch.

validation.judge_notes: REVISE: [critical] The evidence section explicitly lists the license claim as 'verified: false'. While the LICENSE file excerpt confirms GPLv3, the passport's internal evidence registry contradicts itself by marking it unverified. Furthermore, the risk assessment flags a conflict with 'SL-DEP-02' (closed redistribution), but the passport does not define what SL-DEP-02 is or confirm if this specific project violates it. This creates an unresolved compliance blocker. | [high] The claim of 'full' coverage for Vector Search is unsupported by the provided evidence excerpts. The README and metadata mention 'vector search' in topics/description, but no code, test, or API documentation excerpt demonstrates actual vector indexing or query implementation. Per the rubric, 'verified' requires code/test evidence, not just marketing text. 'Declared' based solely on a description string is insufficient for a 'full' coverage claim. | [high] The claim of 'full' coverage for the SQL Interface is based on 'declared' status using only API metadata. While the README mentions MySQL-compatible protocol, there is no evidence excerpt showing actual SQL parsing code, test cases for SQL queries, or interface implementation details. The rubric requires code/test evidence for verification. | [medium] The passport correctly identifies these as 'partial' coverage with 'inferred' status. However, the notes state Manticore provides the 'underlying storage... required to record diary entries'. This is misleading; Manticore is a search index, not a general-purpose transactional database for recording arbitrary entities without application logic. The evidence does not support any specific 'diary' functionality, which is correct, but the phrasing implies a closer fit than exists. | [low] The README contains specific performance benchmarks. While these are marketing text, they are not verified by any evidence excerpt provided in the passport. The rubric flags 'invented numbers' or overstated maturity. These numbers are present in the README but not validated.

description: Manticore Search is an open-source, fast search database (fork of Sphinx) supporting full-text search, vector search, and SQL. It provides a MySQL-compatible protocol for data manipulation and a native HTTP/JSON API for search operations. It is designed as a high-performance alternative to Elasticsearch.
